$comment: Texts the prototype shows only because of its demo state or its sample data, and the copy the owner kept on purpose. A missing-text finding is not raised for them; each skip is counted under 'Accepted differences' (rule 'reference-<id>', or 'accepted' when given). 'pages' limits a rule to those page ids, 'loginPages' to pages that need the demo login. 'targetTexts' gives the target's wording of a kept string, so scenario copy that differs only by it is accepted too.

rules.reason: The prototype's demo user avatar; the target shows the guest buttons, or the signed-in user's own initials.
The prototype keeps the guest header on signed-in pages; the target is signed in there.
The auth pages' language pill shows the prototype's current language; the language control itself is compared by the login-language-pill scenario.
Sample city filters; the target lists the cities of its live listings.
Sample category names; the target shows the live category tree.
Sample seller name; the target shows the seller from the live API.
Sample company name; the target shows the company from the live API.
Sample chat partner and ad; the target shows the demo account's own conversations.
The sample ad lists features; the target renders the block only for an ad that has features (components/ads/AdSpecs.tsx), and the live ad the gate opens has none.
orders.list.title: the page lists purchases and sales, so the owner kept "My orders" (PR #274, decision of 2026-10-15).
orders.list.caption_purchases / caption_sales: one caption per list keeps the buyer and seller views apart (PR #274).

texts: A reasonable offer increases your chance of acceptance by 70%.
targetTexts: Introduce yourself or explain why you're making this offer. A friendly message helps.
rules.reason: orders.deal.offer_hint: the reference claims an unsubstantiated 70% (PR #274).

texts: No payment will be processed at this stage.
targetTexts: No payment happens now: you pay the seller in cash at handover.
rules.reason: orders.deal.buy_step_3 keeps the cash-at-handover fact the reference drops (PR #274).

targetTexts: Describe the condition, what's included and why you're selling
rules.reason: post_ad.basic.description_placeholder: the reference repeats the title example in the description (PR #274).
